Security Tech Lead

Orysys Limited    Colombo • Full-time

Job Description

The Security Tech Lead owns the technical direction of security across Orysys's products, cloud infrastructure and engineering practices, and leads a team of 3-6 security engineers. You will be the hands-on expert who designs secure architecture, drives vulnerability reduction, and makes security a built-in part of how engineering ships.

Key Responsibilities:

Technical Leadership

  • Set the security technical roadmap and standards, aligned with business risk and engineering priorities.
  • Lead, mentor and grow security engineers; run design reviews, code reviews and technical hiring.
  • Act as the security voice in architecture decisions and partner with engineering, DevOps, product and compliance leads.

Application and product security

  • Run threat modelling and security design reviews for new features, services and integrations.
  • Build and maintain a secure SDLC: SAST, DAST, SCA, secrets scanning and container scanning in CI/CD pipelines.
  • Own the vulnerability management process, from triage and risk rating to remediation tracking and SLAs.
  • Coordinate penetration tests and bug bounty findings, and verify fixes.

Cloud and infrastructure security

  • Secure cloud environments ([AWS/Azure / GCP]): IAM, network segmentation, encryption, key management and logging.
  • Define infrastructure-as-code guardrails and cloud security posture management (CSPM).
  • Harden Kubernetes, containers and CI/CD systems against supply-chain and misconfiguration risks.

Detection and incident response

  • Design logging, monitoring and alerting with the SOC or SIEM team.
  • Lead technical response to security incidents, including containment, forensics and post-incident reviews.
  • Maintain and test incident response runbooks.

Governance and compliance

  • Translate frameworks (ISO 27001/SOC2/PCI DSS/GDPR) into practical technical controls.
  • Provide evidence and technical input for audits, customer security questionnaires and risk assessments.
  • Run security awareness and secure coding training for engineering teams.

Requirements & Qualifications:

  • 7+ years in information security or security engineering, including 2+ years leading engineers or technical projects.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • Strong application security knowledge: OWASP Top 10, secure code review, threat modelling (e.g. STRIDE) and common vulnerability classes.
  • Hands-on cloud security experience in at least one major provider (AWS/Azure / GCP).
  • Working knowledge of networking, identity (OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML), cryptography basics and PKI.
  • Experience integrating security tools into CI/CD pipelines (e.g. GitHub Actions, GitLab Cl, Jenkins).
  • Scripting or coding ability in at least one language (Python,
    Go, Java or similar) to automate security work.
  • Experience leading incident response and writing clear post-incident reports.
  • Clear communicator who can explain risk to engineers, executives and auditors alike.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Certifications such as CISSP, OSCP, CCSP, AWS/Azure/GCP security specialty, or GIAC (GWAPT, GCIH).
  • Kubernetes and container security experience (e.g. Falco, OPA/Gatekeeper, image signing).
  • Experience with SIEM/SOAR, EDR and cloud-native detection tools.
  • Prior work in a regulated sector such as fintech, banking. healthcare or SaaS serving enterprise customers.
  • Experience building a security program or team from an early stage.
  • Contributions to the security community: CVES, open- source tools, talks or CTFs.
